evidence.quote: they struggle to internalize microservice dependency constraints and therefore tend to over-trust the most salient downstream symptoms (symptom amplification)
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap 1：LLM RCA 不理解拓扑，易症状放大。

evidence.quote: microservice environments are inherently non-stationary: autoscaling, rolling updates, and evolving call graphs introduce distribution shifts and out-of-distribution (OOD) behaviors.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap 2：拓扑漂移/OOD。

evidence.quote: stores solved incidents as compact records consisting of candidate-centric topology fingerprints, symptom-token sets, validated hypotheses with key evidence, and mitigation outcomes.
evidence.support_explanation: 留存的非权重对象：分层事件记忆。

evidence.quote: Updates follow a hierarchical policy: pod-level patterns are refreshed more aggressively than service- and node-level patterns, stabilizing slow-changing infrastructure knowledge while tracking fast-changing deployment dynamics.
evidence.support_explanation: 分层更新速率。

evidence.quote: To prevent redundancy collapse, similarity-aware stochastic forgetting is applied when inserting a new incident representation
evidence.support_explanation: 遗忘规则：相似度比例的随机丢弃。

evidence.quote: During deployment, high-confidence diagnoses (strong support, low missingness, and consistent topology constraints) are treated as pseudo-labeled samples and accumulated in a buffer
evidence.support_explanation: 测试时适应：系统自判的高置信诊断作伪标签。

evidence.quote: Once the buffer reaches a batch size, the encoder is updated with a conservative objective:
evidence.support_explanation: 权重更新(编码器)，带 L2 锚定到部署前参数。

evidence.quote: Instead of asking a single model to read all signals and directly output a root cause, TopoEvo decomposes diagnosis into 5 specialized roles that communicate through structured artifacts:
evidence.support_explanation: HET 多智能体分工，经结构化制品通信。

evidence.quote: For each hypothesis, the judge checks temporal precedence (whether the proposed root cause becomes abnormal no later than downstream symptoms within a slack), path consistency (whether evidence is located along the hypothesized route and consistent with the dependency graph), and template consistency (whether the collected evidence matches the intended failure template under strict/relaxed criteria to handle partial observability).
evidence.support_explanation: 裁判的三条检查：时序、路径、模板。

evidence.quote: It is collected via controlled fault injection on a real-world deployed microservice system,
evidence.support_explanation: 数据集 A：受控故障注入。

evidence.quote: The platform contains 12 microservices and 48 pods, and the dataset records multimodal observability (metrics, logs, and traces) during real incidents.
evidence.support_explanation: 数据集 B：生产事件，规模仅给出服务/Pod 数，事件数与划分未给。

evidence.quote: For efficiency, we measure end-to-end diagnosis latency (wall-clock time per incident, including agent/tool calls when applicable).
evidence.support_explanation: 定义了延迟指标，但后文无结果。

evidence.quote: For all LLM-based components, GPT-4o-2024-11-20 is used as the backbone model to ensure consistent reasoning ability across different settings.
evidence.support_explanation: 统一 LLM 主干。

evidence.quote: Overall, removing any key component consistently degrades performance.
evidence.support_explanation: 消融总述。

evidence.quote: This confirms that continual experience reuse and adaptation help maintain RCA robustness as system behavior shifts.
evidence.support_explanation: SEM 的作用仅由 w/o SEM 的下降推出；该下降同时含记忆与权重适应两部分。

evidence.quote: On the node level and Dataset B, although TAMO is stronger on Acc@1/3, TopoEvo consistently ranks second and achieves the best Acc@5, indicating stronger
evidence.support_explanation: 正文称数据集 B 上 TAMO 的 Acc@1 更强，而表 I 中 B 的 TopoEvo Acc@1(75.66)>TAMO(72.22)。

evidence.quote: In future work, we plan to (1) strengthen causal validation beyond topology-consistent verification (e.g., intervention-aware checks), (2) design safer and more cost-aware continual adaptation policies under drift, and (3) extend evaluation to more heterogeneous microservice platforms and observability conditions.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者自认：持续适应策略的安全/成本、因果验证、多平台评测为未来工作。

evidence.quote: it achieves higher Token Purity and Normalized Mutual Information, while yielding lower Intra-token Variance.
